title: Q-KG-replication-ledger: give replication-ledger its self-maintained knowledge graph (KGRAPH-1)
body:
**Owner:** knowledge
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation kgraph --list shows `replication-ledger: live`
**Status:** open

Replication Ledger is moving to its own repository. Land the graph with the move: vendor seed/worker/src/knowledge.js, mappers for its studies and replications, runKg on its clock, /api/graph and a live /graph page, then mark it live in doctrine/knowledge-graph.json. Unlearn is the reference tenant (ultrastable/unlearn worker/graph.js).

Prediction: kg_nodes for tenant replication-ledger > 0 within 168 h.

size: M

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation kgraph --check, with replication-ledger live in doctrine/knowledge-graph.json.
